data.description: Sky-High Sanctuary | Rare Oversized 2BR with Sweeping Marina Views
data.display_address: Jumeirah Living Marina Gate, Marina Gate, Dubai Marina, Dubai
data.long_description:
Perched on one of the highest floors of the prestigious Jumeirah Living Marina Gate, this rare 2-bedroom apartment offers an exceptionally large layout rarely found at this address — combining space, privacy, and uninterrupted Marina views in one of Dubai's most sought-after waterfront addresses.

Property Highlights:

Unique High-Floor Position — Unobstructed, panoramic views over Dubai Marina's skyline and waterway
Expansive Layout — One of the largest 2-bedroom floorplans available in the building, offering generous living, dining, and bedroom proportions rarely seen in standard units
2 Bedrooms, En-suite Bathrooms — Spacious master suite plus a second well-proportioned bedroom, ideal for families or professionals
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows — Flooding the apartment with natural light and framing the Marina views from nearly every room
Premium Branded Residence — Part of the Jumeirah Living collection, known for five-star service standards and finishes
World-Class Amenities — Access to infinity pool, fully equipped gym, spa, concierge, valet parking, and 24/7 security
Prime Marina Gate Location — Steps from Dubai Marina Walk, JBR Beach, dining, retail, and Marina Mall, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
This is a rare opportunity to own one of the most desirable layouts in Marina Gate — perfect for end-users seeking a luxurious lifestyle residence or investors targeting a high-demand rental asset in Dubai Marina.

Contact us today to arrange a private viewing of this exceptional high-floor unit.
